definitions.name: App
definitions.description: Blocking Sulfur window. Pages and native windows never enter game saves.

definitions.name: Collision2D
definitions.description: AABB overlap events (detection only); touching edges do not overlap.

definitions.name: CommandOptions
definitions.description:
Snapshot argv without the executable and query options without a schema.

Options accept --name=value or --name value. Bare options return True;
declare known boolean flags to keep them from consuming a positional value.
Repeated options use the last occurrence, including across queried aliases.
A standalone -- ends option parsing. Values remain strings.

members.name: positionals
members.description: Return positional arguments in order, excluding option values.

members.name: get
members.description: Query aliases, or a single positional index (negative indexes work).

definitions.name: Effect
definitions.description: A nested, turn-based effect. Connect proc to implement its game rules.

definitions.name: Entity
definitions.description: A named container with a spawn trigger; game rules choose its behavior.

definitions.name: FrontEnd
definitions.description:
Optional front-end with Wednesware Fluorine; no rendering or web server included.

Page/Site instances are external runtime objects and intentionally are not
serialized. Attach them again after loading a saved game.

definitions.name: Gravity
definitions.description: Add before Velocity for semi-implicit Euler integration; positive y is down.

definitions.name: GridMovement
definitions.description: Move a selected Stage2D entity; walls and occupied solid cells block movement.

definitions.name: Multiplayer
definitions.description:
One authoritative Session shared by all Beryllium clients.

bind(session, page) returns a runtime binding. Call binding.run() to host.
Startup URLs are printed by default; set print_url=False to disable them.
Page callbacks should be @Session.action methods. The binding survives game
replacement; hosts, clients and subscriptions are deliberately not serialized.

definitions.name: ShellInput
definitions.description: Explicit blocking prompts; feed() also supports scripted input without a TTY.
warnings: Iodine is optional when iodine=True; read() is blocking.

definitions.name: SoundEffects
definitions.description: Named, nonblocking Carbon WAV effects; stop only this adapter's sounds.

definitions.name: SoundPlayer
definitions.description: Nonblocking Carbon WAV playback by path; playback is runtime only.

members.name: play
members.description: Request playback of a WAV filename or pathlib.Path.

members.name: stop
members.description: Stop a path requested by this player in the active game.

members.name: stop_all
members.description: Stop this game's requested paths without calling Carbon's stop_all.

definitions.name: StageRenderer
definitions.description:
Character-cell terminal renderer for a Stage2D, without owning the stage.

Connect stage.out.placed/moved/removed to matching renderer inputs.
Rendering is explicit via render() or the draw input, making it usable in
both turn-based and real-time games without unsolicited terminal output.
